cards.prompt: NEW SCENE, not a variation of a standing sword portrait. Generate ONE complete portrait 4:5 illustration for the Kalistar game, without card frame, writing, UI, logo or watermark. Reference1 establishes adult 2B's IDENTITY ONLY: short white bob, black blindfold, worn black embroidered puff-sleeve combat dress, gloves and tall boots. Reference2 is the long sword shape: straight large white/silver blade, black inset, dark crossguard, white wrapped long handle. Reference3/4 establish Kalistar STYLE: visibly painted facets and brushstrokes, expressive materials, narrative illustration, not photoreal, not glossy 3D, not anime. Scene 'Ce qui mérite de vivre': inside a quiet abandoned factory alcove overtaken by a few roots, 2B has knelt on one knee beside a small battered round-headed machine sitting on the floor. She is placing a single tiny white flower in its open metal palm. A rare hesitant gentleness in her visible mouth and bent posture, a wordless pause in the war. Her magnificent LONG straight sword is at rest beside her, point planted in a crack, hilt above her shoulder; physically grounded, unmistakably long, no curved blade, no axe. Wider full-figure storytelling composition: 2B at centre-left in three-quarter side view, the small seated machine at centre-right below her, their hands and the flower meet near centre. Her entire head, kneeling body, both arms, gloves and bent leg are readable. The machine must be small and simple and never compete with 2B. Different from an upright heroic portrait: she looks downward toward the machine, no staring at viewer, no guard pose, no ruined-city skyline. Cool muted green-grey ambient light, one soft off-canvas shaft of daylight catches white hair, flower and silver sword. Spacious broad dark factory wall planes and one broken window, NO dense machinery, wires, buildings or extra decorative props. Painterly grain and worn cloth as in Kalistar reference images. Composition must read at small size inside 737x921; keep the faces, joined hands and sword guard in central 75%. Gentle and emotionally specific, not mournful spectacle or magical fireworks.

cards.prompt: Generate ONE new 4:5 portrait Kalistar story illustration, full bleed, no frame, text, stats, logos or UI. IMPORTANT: a genuinely different NARRATIVE SCENE, not a standing fist portrait. Reference1 establishes BALMHYR's identity only: stocky broad older dwarf, deeply weathered paternal face, long silver-white braided beard, braided-back hair, ochre scarf, worn leather, chain and iron with bronze fittings. Keep him recognizable. Reference2 establishes his worn articulated iron gauntlet, crowned cuff and grey mineral inset, use it naturally on his hand. References3/4 are the Kalistar art direction: confident textured brushwork, chiseled light planes, natural expressiveness and aged materials, never glossy 3D, anime or photography. Scene 'La leçon dans la pierre': in the small open practice court outside his simple canyon refuge, Balmhyr demonstrates a compact precise punch into a waist-high upright stone training block. The stone splits along one clean fissure under his gauntleted fist. His weight is shifted low, short sturdy legs firmly planted apart, torso in three-quarter SIDE view and face in profile focused down the arm. He is actively turning into the punch, NOT standing in guard with fists raised toward the viewer. His free hand is open and balanced back near his waist, readable anatomy, only two arms and hands. Full body action composition with boots included, fist and splitting stone near centre-right, face upper-centre-left; gray mineral light faintly travels along the fissure and gauntlet seams, a few heavy stone pieces fall but NO explosive shower. Rolled sleeves expose strong forearms, scarf drapes naturally, less armor than his ruler portrait. The feeling is a patient mentor showing how to place force, not berserk rage; a slight focused smile after years of practice. Simple pale canyon wall and a broad shadow from the refuge behind him, two or three readable environmental masses only, NO crowd, no city skyline, no axe or sword. Keep face, main fist and impact in central 75% of the picture, with generous room for card stat columns. Warm late afternoon ochre light balanced with cool stone gray. Rich painterly grain, tactile cloth and metal, visually consistent with supplied Kalistar references.
